title: Engineer, Software - Java FullStack [T500-30251]
description:
**About T-Mobile:**

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience.

**About TMUS Global Solutions:**

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions.

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with experience in Java, NodeJS, JavaScript, VueJS, Golang and SQL. You will work alongside software, network, and systems engineers to design, implement, and deploy scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and operate reliably in highly available environments.

As part of our team, you will participate in and sometimes lead architecture and design efforts focused on creating applications and supporting backend data processes. These applications empower our network teams to monitor our industry leading 5G network at T-Mobile by leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Such as Kafka, Kubernetes and Spark/Scala. Our culture promotes innovation, agile methodologies, and transparency—if you’re up for the challenge, apply today!

* Design, Build, enhance full-stack applications, covering front-end (React / Angular / Vue) and back-end (Node.js / Java / .NET / Python / Golang) services.
* Develop & Maintain APIs (REST / GraphQL) and microservices for scalable, secure data exchange across systems.
* Implement Front-End Features including responsive UIs, reusable components, accessibility compliance, and design system alignment.
* Design and Optimize Databases (SQL/NoSQL), ensuring data integrity, indexing, caching, and performance tuning.
* Automate Build & Deployment Pipelines using CI/CD practices with Gitlab.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Architects to refine requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Conduct Testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), troubleshoot defects, and support QA / UAT phases for production readiness.
* Ensure compliance with platform best practices, coding standards, and security requirements.
* Document Solutions including architecture, APIs, deployment pipelines, and coding standards for maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* 70:30 ratio expected between development and operations responsibilities.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. a
* 2-4 years of technical engineering experience, including one of the following development languages (Java, NodeJS, JavaScript, VueJS, Golang and SQL).
* Proven experience designing and implementing REST APIs.
* Strong proficiency with operating systems such as Linux and Windows.
* Knowledge of operations (Ops) and system administration concepts.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience writing technical documentation and collaborating in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
* Proficiency in additional programming languages such as Python or Perl.
* Experience working with databases and SQL (Oracle, MySQL).
* Familiarity working with messaging systems like Kafka

TMUS India Private Limited, operating as TMUS Global Solutions, has engaged ANSR, Inc. ("ANSR") as its exclusive recruiting partner. That means that any communications regarding TMUS Global Solutions opportunities or employment offers will be issued only through ANSR and the 1Recruit platform. If you receive a communication or offer from another individual or entity, please notify TMUS Global Solutions immediately.

TMUS Global Solutions will never seek any payment or other compensation during the hiring process or request sensitive personal data (such as bank details or government-issued identification numbers) prior to a candidate’s acceptance of a formal offer.

title: Fresher - ERP Full Stack Developer (MERN & NestJS)
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
Fresher – ERP Full Stack Developer (MERN & NestJS)
  
  
**Company:**
Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Department:**
Product Development
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  

* Role Overview

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is looking for enthusiastic, analytical, and technology-driven freshers to join our ERP development team.
  
  
The selected candidates will work on GwayERP and other enterprise application projects, gaining practical experience in developing scalable business applications using
**NestJS, Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and modern AI-assisted development tools**
.
  
  
This role is suitable for candidates who have a strong foundation in programming, a genuine interest in software development, and the willingness to learn new technologies, understand business processes, and contribute to real-world ERP applications.
  
  
Candidates will participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirement understanding, development, debugging, testing, deployment support, and maintenance.
  
  
We are looking for individuals who can combine
**strong technical fundamentals, rapid learning, AI-assisted development, problem-solving, ownership, and accountability**
to deliver quality software efficiently.
  
  
****Our Development Philosophy:****
**Understand the Requirement → Develop Rapidly → Validate Thoroughly → Deliver Quality → Continuously Improve**
Candidates are not expected to know every technology on their first day. However, they must demonstrate a strong willingness to learn, experiment, solve problems independently, and apply their knowledge to practical development challenges.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* ERP Application Development
* Understand ERP requirements and business workflows.
* Develop and maintain ERP modules under the guidance of experienced developers.
* Understand the relationship between different ERP modules.
* Implement new features and enhancements.
* Fix bugs and resolve application issues.
* Follow established development standards.
* Ensure new developments do not unnecessarily affect existing functionality.
* Participate in the complete development lifecycle.
* Learn how enterprise applications support real-world business operations.

The candidate will gain exposure to integrated ERP applications covering multiple business functions.
  
  

* Understanding ERP Business Processes

**Develop An Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows, Including:**

* Sales
* Purchase
* Procurement
* Inventory
* Production and Manufacturing
* Finance and Accounts
* Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
* Service Management
* HR and Payroll
* Project Management
* Reports and Dashboards
* Master Data Management
* Approval Workflows
* User and Role Management
* Notifications
* API Integrations
* Document Management

The candidate should learn to translate a business requirement into a technical implementation.
  
  
**Business Requirement → Workflow → API → Database → User Interface → Validation → Testing**
A willingness to understand why a feature is required, rather than simply implementing instructions, is essential.
  
  

* Full Stack Development

The candidate will work on both backend and frontend development.
  
  
Backend Development
  
  
**Learn, Develop, And Maintain Backend Services Using:**

* NestJS
* Node.js
* TypeScript
* REST API development
* Mongoose ODM
* MongoDB
* API integration
* Request validation
* Error handling
* Authentication and authorization
* Business logic implementation
* Backend debugging and optimization

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Developing backend functionality.
* Implementing APIs based on requirements.
* Integrating APIs with frontend applications.
* Debugging backend errors.
* Following existing architectural patterns.
* Writing clean, reusable, and maintainable code.

Frontend Development
  
  
**Develop And Maintain User Interfaces Using:**

* React.js
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Redux
* Redux-Saga
* Formik
* React Hook Form (RHF)
* Reusable React components
* State management
* REST API integration
* Form validation
* Responsive UI development

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Developing reusable frontend components.
* Implementing forms and business workflows.
* Integrating APIs.
* Managing application state.
* Debugging UI issues.
* Implementing appropriate validation and error handling.
* Following existing UI/UX designs.
* Ensuring functionality works correctly across supported browsers.
* MongoDB & Database Development

The candidate will gain practical experience working with MongoDB in enterprise applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding MongoDB collections and documents.
* Working with Mongoose schemas.
* Developing database queries.
* Implementing CRUD operations.
* Understanding relationships between ERP entities.
* Learning MongoDB aggregation pipelines.
* Debugging database-related issues.
* Following data validation standards.
* Understanding data integrity and consistency.
* Learning basic database performance optimization.

The candidate must handle database changes carefully, particularly when working with existing ERP data.
  
  

* AI-Assisted Development

**Active use of AI tools for software development is an important expectation of this role.**
The candidate should learn to use AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed, accuracy, and problem-solving ability.
  
  
**AI Tools Should Be Used To Support:**

* Understanding unfamiliar code.
* Generating code suggestions.
* Debugging errors.
* Explaining technical concepts.
* Refactoring code.
* Developing API functionality.
* Creating test cases.
* Understanding database queries.
* Preparing technical documentation.
* Investigating implementation approaches.
* Identifying potential edge cases.
* Improving repetitive development activities.

The candidate must understand that AI-generated code should never be accepted blindly.
  
  
All AI-assisted code must be reviewed, understood, validated, and tested before being used in the application.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Continuously Learn To Answer:**

* Can this requirement be implemented more efficiently?
* Can AI help identify the root cause of this bug?
* Can repetitive development work be automated?
* Can the solution be made more accurate and maintainable?
* Have the generated changes been properly tested?

**The expectation is not simply to use AI, but to use it intelligently to produce better software in less time.**

* Rapid Development & Productivity

The candidate should develop the ability to complete assigned development tasks efficiently without compromising quality.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding requirements before coding.
* Breaking tasks into manageable steps.
* Reusing existing components and services.
* Following established coding patterns.
* Avoiding unnecessary code duplication.
* Identifying and resolving development blockers.
* Minimizing avoidable rework.
* Completing assigned tasks within agreed timelines.
* Using AI tools appropriately to accelerate development.
* Continuously improving technical skills and productivity.

The objective is to deliver
**more useful, reliable functionality in less time**
, rather than simply writing more code.
  
  

* Ownership & Accountability

We expect candidates to demonstrate responsibility for the tasks assigned to them.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding assigned requirements clearly.
* Taking responsibility for task completion.
* Providing progress updates.
* Communicating blockers promptly.
* Meeting agreed delivery timelines.
* Testing completed functionality.
* Fixing issues identified during testing.
* Following tasks through to completion.
* Asking relevant questions when requirements are unclear.
* Learning from mistakes and avoiding repeated errors.
* Documenting important implementation details where required.

Candidates should develop the habit of taking ownership of their work rather than waiting for continuous instructions.
  
  
**If you encounter a problem, investigate it, understand it, attempt a solution, and communicate clearly when assistance is required.**

* Code Quality & Development Standards

The candidate must learn and follow established software development standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Writing clean and readable code.
* Following naming conventions.
* Developing reusable components and services.
* Avoiding unnecessary duplication.
* Implementing proper error handling.
* Following validation standards.
* Understanding separation of concerns.
* Following existing application architecture.
* Participating in code reviews.
* Addressing review feedback.
* Maintaining basic technical documentation.
* Avoiding unnecessary changes to unrelated functionality.

The objective is to develop software that can be maintained and enhanced by other developers.
  
  

* Git, GitHub & Version Control

Practical knowledge of Git and GitHub is expected.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Using Git for version control.
* Creating and managing branches.
* Committing code with meaningful messages.
* Pushing changes to GitHub.
* Understanding pull requests.
* Resolving basic merge conflicts.
* Following the organization's branching strategy.
* Keeping changes organized.
* Participating in code reviews.
* Learning how version control supports collaborative development.

Candidates must understand the importance of protecting the existing codebase and avoiding unapproved changes to production code.
  
  

* Jenkins, CI/CD & Deployment Support

The candidate will gain exposure to automated build and deployment processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding Jenkins pipelines.
* Learning continuous integration and continuous deployment.
* Supporting application build processes.
* Investigating build failures.
* Understanding application deployment workflows.
* Supporting deployment-related troubleshooting.
* Following release procedures.
* Learning how code moves from development to testing and production.
* Coordinating with the DevOps team when environment-related issues arise.

The candidate should gradually develop a practical understanding of the complete software delivery lifecycle.
  
  

* Debugging & Problem Solving

Strong analytical and problem-solving ability is essential.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Learn To Investigate:**

* Frontend errors.
* Backend errors.
* API failures.
* Database issues.
* Integration problems.
* Validation errors.
* Unexpected application behaviour.
* Performance issues.
* Business workflow inconsistencies.
* Browser-specific issues.

**The Expected Troubleshooting Approach Is:**
**Understand the Problem → Reproduce It → Investigate the Cause → Implement a Solution → Test the Fix → Prevent Recurrence**
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to investigate problems systematically rather than relying only on trial and error.
  
  

* Testing & Application Reliability

The candidate will be responsible for validating assigned development work before considering it complete.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Testing new functionality.
* Validating API responses.
* Testing input validation.
* Checking error handling.
* Verifying database operations.
* Testing relevant business workflows.
* Identifying edge cases.
* Fixing defects.
* Supporting QA activities.
* Retesting resolved issues.
* Ensuring existing functionality has not been unintentionally affected.

The candidate should understand that a feature is not complete merely because the code has been written.
  
  
**A task is complete when the functionality works as expected and the implementation has been appropriately validated.**

* Current & Future Product Development

The candidate will contribute to the continued development of GwayERP and other enterprise applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding the existing application architecture.
* Learning the purpose of different ERP modules.
* Developing new functionality.
* Supporting enhancements to existing modules.
* Fixing reported defects.
* Implementing API integrations.
* Improving existing code where required.
* Learning application performance optimization.
* Following established architectural patterns.
* Adapting to new technical requirements.
* Contributing to future product development.
* Technical Learning & Continuous Improvement

We are looking for candidates who are serious about building a career in software development.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To:**

* Learn unfamiliar technologies when required.
* Research technical problems independently.
* Read official documentation.
* Understand the code before modifying it.
* Practise effective debugging.
* Learn from code reviews.
* Improve programming fundamentals.
* Develop a deeper understanding of ERP workflows.
* Explore AI-assisted development methods.
* Improve development speed without sacrificing quality.
* Document useful findings and solutions.
* Stay updated with relevant development practices.

**Your ability to learn, apply knowledge, and improve continuously is more important than knowing every technology at the time of joining.**

* Required Technical Skills

Backend
  
  

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Fundamental understanding of Node.js.
* Basic understanding of NestJS or willingness to learn it.
* Understanding of REST APIs.
* Basic knowledge of backend application development.

Frontend
  
  

* Basic knowledge of React.js.
* Understanding of HTML and CSS.
* JavaScript fundamentals.
* Basic understanding of component-based development.
* Familiarity with frontend API integration.

Database
  
  

* Basic understanding of MongoDB.
* Familiarity with CRUD operations.
* Willingness to learn Mongoose ODM.
* Understanding of data structures and validation.

Development Tools
  
  

* Git and GitHub fundamentals.
* Familiarity with VS Code or a similar development environment.
* Willingness to learn Jenkins and CI/CD.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.

Good to Have
  
  

* TypeScript.
* NestJS.
* Redux and Redux-Saga.
* Formik.
* React Hook Form.
* MongoDB aggregation.
* Docker fundamentals.
* Basic API testing.
* Familiarity with ERP or business applications.
* Eligibility & Experience
* Fresh graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline may apply.
* Candidates with 0–1 year of relevant experience are welcome.
* Academic projects, internships, personal projects, and practical coding experience will be considered.
* Candidates should have a genuine interest in full-stack development.
* A strong understanding of programming fundamentals is expected.
* Practical knowledge demonstrated through projects is an advantage.

**We value demonstrated ability, learning potential, problem-solving skills, and commitment over the number of technologies listed on a resume.**

* Professional Qualities

**The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate:**

* Strong willingness to learn.
* Logical and analytical thinking.
* Problem-solving ability.
* Attention to detail.
* Ownership of assigned work.
* Accountability.
* Good communication.
* Time management.
* Adaptability.
* Curiosity about technology.
* Willingness to accept feedback.
* Ability to work collaboratively.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Responsible use of AI tools.
* Interest in understanding business processes.
* Performance Expectations

The candidate's progress and performance will be evaluated based on:
  
  

* Understanding of assigned requirements.
* Quality of code.
* Development speed and consistency.
* Accuracy of implementation.
* Ability to debug issues.
* Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines.
* Effective use of AI-assisted development.
* Reduction in avoidable rework.
* Adherence to coding standards.
* Quality of testing.
* Understanding of ERP workflows.
* Collaboration with the development team.
* Willingness to learn and apply new technologies.
* Improvement in individual productivity over time.

The expectation is to progressively become a dependable developer who can handle increasingly complex ERP development tasks.
  
  

* Growth Opportunity

This role provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in building enterprise ERP applications.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Develop Skills Across:**
**Programming Fundamentals → Full Stack Development → ERP Workflows → API Development → Database Design → AI-Assisted Development → Testing → Deployment → Production Application Development**
As technical capability improves, the candidate will have the opportunity to work on more complex modules, integrations, application enhancements, and development responsibilities.
  
  

* The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a fresher who is enthusiastic about software development and interested in solving real business problems through technology.
  
  
You do not need to know everything before joining.
  
  
**However, You Should Be Willing To:**

* Learn new technologies.
* Understand business requirements.
* Write and test code.
* Investigate errors.
* Use AI tools intelligently.
* Take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Meet agreed timelines.
* Improve your technical skills continuously.
* Understand how ERP applications support businesses.
* Deliver reliable and maintainable software.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can combine
**rapid learning, disciplined development, AI-assisted productivity, and a strong sense of responsibility**
.
  
  
Our Expectation
  
  
We do not expect you to be an expert on your first day.
  
  
We expect you to become better every day.
  
  
If you are ready to learn, build, experiment, solve problems, and contribute to real-world ERP products, we would like to hear from you.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates should submit their application through the official recruitment website.
  
  
For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website.
  
  
Kindly do not make phone calls, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants.
  
  
We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited.

Industry: B2B SaaS / Cybersecurity

About Doverunner

Doverunner is a leading cybersecurity company specializing in advanced application security, mobile protection, and threat mitigation solutions for digital-first businesses.

We work with enterprises across BFSI, Gaming, Fintech, and O2O ecosystems to secure applications, transactions, and customer trust at scale.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced DevOps / Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in India / Seoul. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our automated build and deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application monitoring systems. This role requires a technically rigorous individual who can work independently, communicate findings clearly, and consistently propose improvements that raise the reliability and efficiency of our systems.

As a member of a cross-functional team, the DevOps Engineer will collaborate closely with software developers, quality assurance engineers, and product stakeholders. A working proficiency in English is required, as the role involves reading international technical documentation, communicating with external vendors, and participating in periodic cross-regional meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Automation and CI/CD

* Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD
* Automate build, test, and deployment workflows to minimize manual intervention and reduce the risk of human error
* Establish and enforce GitOps practices for consistent, auditable infrastructure and application deployments
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing pipelines to reduce overall build and release cycle times

Application Monitoring and Observability

* Deploy and manage monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, the ELK stack, or Datadog
* Define and maintain service-level indicators, objectives, and agreements in collaboration with product and engineering leadership
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks and escalation procedures for production incidents
* Lead post-incident reviews, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence
* Proactively analyze system metrics and trends to identify potential issues before they impact end users

Infrastructure Management and Infrastructure as Code

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including workload scheduling, network policy, autoscaling, and resource optimization
* Maintain configuration management tooling using Ansible or equivalent solutions
* Continuously evaluate and optimize cloud resource utilization and associated costs

Security and Compliance

* Integrate security scanning tools into CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, container image scanning, and dependency auditing
* Manage secrets, credentials, and sensitive configuration using HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or equivalent
* Ensure infrastructure and application configurations comply with internal security policies and any applicable regulatory requirements
* Apply least-privilege principles consistently across IAM roles, service accounts, and network access controls.

Continuous Improvement and Collaboration

* Regularly evaluate existing tools, processes, and architectures and present concrete recommendations for improvement
* Produce and maintain clear documentation covering infrastructure design, operational procedures, and architectural decisions
* Support development teams in improving local development environments and reducing environment-related inconsistencies
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, contributing a DevOps and reliability-focused perspective
* Communicate technical status, incident updates, and improvement proposals in English when required, both in writing and verbally

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of professional experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or infrastructure engineering role
* Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or a comparable platform
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes in a production environment
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, or Go
* Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack
* English language proficiency sufficient for reading technical documentation and for written and verbal professional communication

Preferred

* Experience implementing GitOps workflows using ArgoCD or Flux
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd
* Background in chaos engineering practices and tools
* Experience managing database infrastructure and coordinating schema migrations within a DevOps workflow

* CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD

title: Senior Platform Engineer II(Cloudflare & Cloud Networking)
description:
**Job Title: Senior Platform Engineer II, Cloudflare & Cloud Networking (AWS or GCP)**

**About the Role**

Design, deliver, and operate enterprise Cloudflare services integrated with AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Deep networking expertise in either AWS or GCP is required; experience across both platforms is advantageous. You will own secure application onboarding from existing cloud infrastructure to Cloudflare for DNS, Web Application Firewall (WAF), load balancing, and Cloudflare Tunnel capabilities. The role requires strong Layer 3 networking, hands-on Cloudflare operations, infrastructure-as-code delivery using Terraform and Spacelift, systematic troubleshooting, and end-to-end ownership of resilient edge and cloud connectivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Own and enhance the Cloudflare edge platform, including authoritative and proxied DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, load balancers, health monitors, traffic steering, TLS, and Cloudflare Tunnels.

Lead application onboarding and migration from AWS or GCP to Cloudflare, covering discovery, dependency mapping, traffic-flow design, origin readiness, DNS cutover, validation, rollback, and production stabilization.

Design and operate Layer 3 networking in at least one cloud platform: AWS networking such as VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, peering, NAT, endpoints, security groups, and network ACLs; or GCP networking such as VPCs, Shared VPC, peering, routes, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Private Google Access, firewall policies, and load balancers.

Design secure connectivity between Cloudflare and AWS or GCP origins using Cloudflare Tunnel and approved public or private origin patterns; enforce origin isolation, least-privilege access, segmentation, and controlled egress.

Develop DNS architecture across Cloudflare and Amazon Route 53 or Google Cloud DNS, including delegation, records, split-horizon DNS, resolver and forwarding paths, DNSSEC, proxy modes, TTL strategy, and controlled migration cutovers.

Configure and tune Cloudflare WAF managed and custom rules, rate limiting, bot controls, DDoS protections, TLS policies, certificates, and origin controls based on application risk.

Build highly available Cloudflare load-balancing designs using origin pools, health monitors, failover, session-affinity requirements, and geographic or latency-based traffic steering.

Troubleshoot Layer 3 through Layer 7 issues using Cloudflare analytics, packet captures, route analysis, DNS tools, HTTP traces, TLS inspection, AWS VPC Flow Logs or GCP VPC Flow Logs, and origin or load-balancer logs.

Develop, publish, and maintain reusable Terraform modules for Cloudflare DNS, Tunnels, WAF, and Load Balancing in the central module registry, enabling consistent self-service adoption by application teams; manage module validation and deployment through Spacelift.

Enforce infrastructure-as-code-only changes and maintain consistent configurations across development, QA, UAT, and production environments through Git-based workflows and policy controls.

Implement monitoring and logging for Cloudflare and cloud network services, including Cloudflare Logpush and audit logs, AWS or GCP flow and DNS logs, load-balancer logs, alerting, dashboards, and SIEM integration.

Participate in incident response and problem management for availability, security, DNS, routing, connectivity, WAF, tunnel, and application-performance events; document root cause and preventive actions.

Partner with application, security, cloud platform, and network teams to define onboarding patterns, resolve dependencies, and deliver low-risk migrations with clear acceptance criteria.

Design for resilience, performance, capacity, and disaster recovery; regularly test health checks, failover behavior, routing, origin reachability, and rollback procedures.

Maintain architecture diagrams, network-flow documentation, DNS inventories, standards, operational runbooks, and change records; support CAB submissions for production changes.

Apply a strong product mindset and take end-to-end accountability for platform capabilities, stakeholder communication, adoption, operational health, and continuous improvement.

**Key Requirements**

8–10 years of experience in network, cloud, or platform engineering, including 3–5+ years of hands-on networking in either AWS or GCP and substantial production support experience.

Expert-level networking knowledge in at least one cloud platform: AWS VPC architecture, routing, Transit Gateway, endpoints, Route 53, and load balancers; or GCP VPC and Shared VPC architecture, routing, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, Private Google Access, firewall policies, and load balancers.

Hands-on Cloudflare experience with DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, load balancing, health monitoring, traffic steering, TLS, analytics, and Cloudflare Tunnels.

Proven experience onboarding or migrating internet-facing applications to Cloudflare with controlled DNS cutovers, origin integration, validation, rollback, and post-production support.

Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP fundamentals, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, Anycast, subnetting, route selection, and Layer 3 through Layer 7 troubleshooting.

Experience securing AWS or GCP origins and network paths using least privilege, segmentation, controlled ingress and egress, encryption, certificate management, and defense-in-depth controls.

Advanced Terraform skills and hands-on experience with Spacelift or a comparable IaC orchestration platform, plus strong Git, module lifecycle, testing, and CI/CD practices.

Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex network and application-delivery issues using logs, metrics, traces, packet-level evidence, and systematic fault isolation.

Experience building operational monitoring, alerting, dashboards, audit trails, and SIEM integrations for Cloudflare and networking services in AWS or GCP.

Strong product mindset with end-to-end accountability for design, implementation, migration, production support, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Clear communication and proven collaboration across application, security, network, and platform engineering teams, including incident and stakeholder updates.

**Nice to Have**

Cloudflare certification, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or an equivalent certification.

Python, PowerShell, Rego, or Bash automation experience and familiarity with Cloudflare, AWS, or GCP APIs.

Experience with hybrid connectivity and centralized inspection using AWS Direct Connect, Google Cloud Interconnect, VPN, AWS Network Firewall, GCP firewall policies, Gateway Load Balancer, or Palo Alto.

Networking experience in the second cloud platform—AWS or GCP—for multi-cloud architecture and migration alignment.

Knowledge of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude and Cursor is a plus.

title: Senior DAM Tech Specialist - Adobe DAM
description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:**
a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**

At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced Adobe AEM Technical Specialist to join our Digital Solutions team in Bangalore. This is a dual-focus role covering both the strategic administration and evolution of the AEM platform, and the hands-on day-to-day support of AEM DAM operations.

This role is focused on hands-on platform support, workflow troubleshooting, and integration maintenance within a live, business-critical environment. You will work on legacy AEM implementation, helping the team stabilize, optimize, and evolve the platform. We are looking for someone who can get into the system, understand how it works, and fix issues pragmatically.

**What you’ll be doing:**

As our Senior DAM Technical Specialist you will be responsible for:

**Platform Administration & Maintenance**

* Manage and maintain the back-office operations of Adobe AEM, including system configuration, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Support day-to-day AEM operations including authoring, publishing, and asset management.
* Oversee and manage AEM workflows and any platform customisations; troubleshoot and fix custom workflow failures or inefficiencies.
* Monitor logs and identify root causes of platform or performance issues.
* Ensure the AEM environment remains up to date with the latest Adobe patches and version releases.
* Manage and plan AEM version upgrades, coordinating all technical and business requirements throughout the upgrade lifecycle.

**Workflow Analysis & Optimisation**

* Analyse and maintain custom AEM workflows.
* Debug and fix workflow failures or inefficiencies.
* Suggest improvements to increase stability and performance.
* Assist in identifying unused assets, workflows, or components; support purge/archive activities to improve platform performance.
* Help document existing setup and reduce reliance on legacy knowledge.

**Technical Liaison & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the primary technical liaison between Adobe’s technical teams and the internal Pentland team.
* Work closely with the business team to understand and implement requirements around user access, platform configuration, and AEM setup.
* Evaluate and validate solutions proposed by Adobe, ensuring they meet internal testing standards and upgrade requirements.

**Integration & Data**

* Lead and support integrations between Adobe AEM and other enterprise systems that consume or exchange data with the AEM backend.
* Maintain and troubleshoot integrations between AEM and external platforms such as Salsify.
* Support validation and fixes for integrations across environments (Dev, Stage, Production).
* Work with APIs and data flows between systems.
* Ensure integration points are robust, well-documented, and maintained through platform changes and upgrades.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Oversee testing for all Adobe-related solutions, ensuring alignment with upgrade and release requirements.
* Support UAT and regression testing for platform changes and releases.
* Validate key user journeys (asset upload, publishing, distribution).
* Define and maintain testing protocols to validate platform stability and functionality after changes.
* Assist with environment configuration and release readiness.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Adobe AEM in a technical capacity, including DAM operations.
* Strong knowledge of AEM back-office operations, including OSGi components, Sling, and JCR/CRX.
* Solid understanding of AEM workflows, architecture, and platform customisations.
* Experience troubleshooting custom workflows and components; Experience supporting AEM environments running on modern Java versions (Java 11/17/21 preferred) and debugging skills.
* Experience working with system logs and error analysis.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing AEM version upgrades and patch management.
* Proven ability to manage integrations between AEM and third-party systems (APIs, data feeds, middleware).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills — able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* Experience working with PIM platforms (e.g. Salsify or similar).
* Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud suite beyond AEM (e.g. Analytics, Target).
* Experience with integrations (APIs, PIM systems) and exposure to legacy AEM setups or major version upgrades.
* Familiarity with SSO and environment configuration.
* Experience in an agile delivery environment.
* Adobe AEM certification.

**Why Pentland Brands?**

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

1. **Talent Team Intro Call**
   - A 30-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
2. **Experience Interview**
   - A more in-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
3. **Final Interview**
   - A final in-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.
